text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
(Run, run, run...! Who cares if my lungs 
burst or my legs tear to shreds!)

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text: (Today—I'll end it all!)

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text: URAAAAAAAGHâ!

Accelerating alongside a roar. A fiery 
fighting spirit swirls around her.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: ...! Haha!

At her fiery passion, Symboli Rudolf 
raised the corner of her mouth in a smile—

With eyes burning like will-o'-the-wisps, 
she truly, for a fleeting moment, locked 
onto Sirius Symboli.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text: Ah!

âIn that moment, a certain visionâa 
memoryâ surfaced in Sirius Symboli's 
mind.

text_block_list.name: Young Sirius
text_block_list.text:
(—Ah, if I surpass that back, I can become 
it! A first-magnitude star that shines 
brighter than anyone else!)

Those childhood days—running across the 
turf, pushing each other to greater 
heights...

text_block_list.name: Young Rudolf
text_block_list.text: ...! Haha!! —Hah!!

"Those 'eyes' were unmistakably fixed 
solely on Sirius Symboli."

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text: 1st place, Symboli Rudolf—!

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text: *pant*, *gasp*, *wheeze*...!

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text: —Dammit!

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
(—Wait a second. Did she... during the 
race...?)

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: ...! Haha!

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
(Just a split second. But in that split 
second, she definitely—"looked at me.")

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text: ...Haha.

—It was an unintentional smile that 
slipped out.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text: (............ ...Why did they laugh?)

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
(Why does having "seen" it matter so 
much...—)

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
(Ah, what do you know. ...You wanted me to 
watch?)

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text: (Just like back then, "me"—)

Amid the deafening cheers rising over 
Nakayama Racecourse—Sirius Symboli stood 
frozen in place.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
..."Lonely" doesn't even begin to cover 
it.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text: "...Ha! Ahaha...! Ahahaha...!"

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text: Aargh, this is so stupid...

And then, suddenly, I look back on the 
azure path I've blazed.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text: (It was a damn blinding turf)

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
(...She was many times stronger than back 
then.)

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text: ... Fine, I'll give you credit for that.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
(Hey, Rudolf. You're never gonna put that 
burden down, are you?)

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
(Because I made up my mind like that, I 
was able to make it this far.)

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
(For the ideal that lies far ahead—to 
stand as 'Symboli Rudolf.')

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text: ...Hah.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
(That's right, I've known all along. 
There's no turning back anymore.)

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text: (Both you, and me. That's why—)

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
Writhe in agony all you want... Just keep 
shining for the sake of "all Umamusume."

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text: Symboli Rudolf.

Though she suffered defeat, her thrilling 
performance in the Arima Kinen earned high 
praise.

"...However, on the way home that day, she 
was unusually quiet."

This Arima Kinen wasn't just any race. It 
carried immense meaning for her.
choice_data_list: (I wonder if everything will be alright.)

text_block_list.text:
While I was fretting like that... she 
suddenly stopped in her tracks ahead of 
me.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
Trainer. I want to talk about the Senior 
Year rotation.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text: Isn't it obvious?

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
Sooner or later, going overseas is a must. 
We'll build our rotation toward that goal.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
You were the one desperately insistin' on 
it, weren't ya? Sayin' we weren't ready 
yet.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
At any rate, with the Osaka Hai and 
Takarazuka Kinen— I'll steadily produce 
results in those big GⅠs.

A future race rotation discussed without 
hesitation. And among those words— 
"Symboli Rudolf" was nowhere to be found.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
...The brightest star in this sky is 
Sirius.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
Someday I'll show that brilliance to the 
world. I don't need any more detours.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text: ...Besides.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
That notebook with the lame name... wasn't 
something to be made fun of after all.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text: Either way, don't worry about it anymore.

Even after that, Sirius Symboli didn't say 
much, but—

It seemed she had truly managed to reclaim 
that light.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
Man, that was an incredible race. The 
Arima Kinen, I mean.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
Doesn't it make you want to run again too, 
Ace?

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
Heheh, yeah... I thought I'd already 
stepped away from the front lines, but—

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
I'm starting to feel like there's still 
something left for me to seize...!

Eras shift in rapid succession. —Next is 
the Osaka Hai. A grand stage where the 
fierce powerhouses of the Senior class 
gather!
